name: The Centre at Copperfield
summary: The Centre at Copperfield is a community shopping center located at one of northwest Houston's busiest intersections on Highway 6 and FM 529. Serving an affluent trade area with over 338,000 residents within 5 miles and average household incomes exceeding $114,000, this Kimco Realty property provides convenient access to retail and services for the growing Copperfield community.
demographics: The Centre at Copperfield serves an affluent suburban Houston market with strong household incomes, as the 5-mile trade area shows a median household income of $88,390 and average household income of $114,199. The center attracts families and professionals from the rapidly growing northwest Houston corridor, with a trade area population exceeding 338,000 within 5 miles. Visitors are predominantly middle to upper-middle income households drawn to the heavily trafficked Highway 6 and FM 529 intersection, one of the area's busiest commercial nodes. The demographic profile indicates a stable, family-oriented customer base with significant purchasing power and preference for convenient neighborhood shopping.
description: The Centre at Copperfield is a prominent community shopping center strategically positioned at the northwest corner of Highway 6 and FM 529 in Houston, Texas, one of the most heavily trafficked intersections in the northwest Houston area. This well-established retail destination serves the thriving Copperfield community and surrounding neighborhoods with convenient access to everyday shopping and services. The center benefits from its location in a high-growth corridor of Houston, drawing from a substantial trade area population of over 338,000 residents within a 5-mile radius. With strong demographics including an average household income exceeding $114,000 within 5 miles, The Centre at Copperfield caters to an affluent suburban market seeking quality retailers and services. The property is professionally managed by Kimco Realty, one of North America's largest publicly traded owners and operators of open-air, grocery-anchored shopping centers, ensuring consistent operations and tenant mix that meets the community's needs.
